subject.title: feat(agents): add scoped command prompt projection

question: Should OpenClaw make plugin CLI effect/exposure/hidden metadata a durable public SDK contract and add a separate host-command prompt projection, or should this work be narrowed to the existing runtime `commands.list` model first?
rationale: The answer fixes the permanent plugin API and command-discovery ownership boundary; tests cannot determine whether the new parallel catalog is the intended product architecture.

options.title: Narrow to the existing runtime catalog
options.body: Reuse or extend the session-scoped command-discovery path, avoiding new public plugin descriptor metadata until a concrete missing capability is demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt the catalog contract explicitly
options.body: Approve the new plugin metadata and static catalog as a supported long-term API, with compatibility documentation and owner-backed runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Defer prompt projection
options.body: Land only a separately approved catalog foundation, then revisit agent prompt guidance after the canonical command model is settled.

recommendation.title: Narrow to the existing runtime catalog
recommendation.body: Reuse or extend the session-scoped command-discovery path, avoiding new public plugin descriptor metadata until a concrete missing capability is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work is the closest evidenced ownership signal for OpenClaw’s live command-catalog behavior.
